title: EOX for upper gastrointestinal cancer
context_label: Locally advanced or metastatic gastro-oesophageal cancer
schedule_label: Day 1 epirubicin and oxaliplatin. Take capecitabine twice daily throughout days 1–21 of each 21-day cycle. There is no planned tablet break between continuing cycles.
schedule_summary: Day 1 epirubicin and oxaliplatin. Take capecitabine twice daily throughout days 1–21 of each 21-day cycle. There is no planned tablet break between continuing cycles. Plan six to eight cycles while treatment is helping and tolerable.
purpose: Treatment aims to control advanced cancer and relieve symptoms. Your team will discuss benefit and side effects at review.
indication_text: Locally advanced or metastatic gastric carcinoma. Locally advanced or metastatic oesophageal carcinoma. Locally advanced or metastatic gastro-oesophageal junction carcinoma.
administration_text: Oxaliplatin can cause cold-triggered tingling or throat symptoms. Report new breathlessness immediately. Swallow capecitabine with water within 30 minutes of a meal. Record your doses. Leave out a missed or vomited dose and call for advice if unwell.
monitoring_summary: Review blood counts, kidney function, electrolytes and liver tests before the next cycle. Ask about cold sensitivity and persistent neuropathy. Record cumulative epirubicin and investigate cardiac symptoms.
review_status: Independent oncology, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Epirubicin
agents.mechanism: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.explanation: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
visual: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.watch: Tell the nurse immediately if the IV site stings or swells.
consent_risks: Risk increases with total exposure. Report breathlessness, swollen ankles or palpitations.
Pain or burning during the injection needs immediate attention. Fever or shivering needs an urgent call.
Hair loss is common. Report ulcers that limit food or fluid intake.

agents.name: Oxaliplatin
agents.explanation: Oxaliplatin makes links within DNA. These interfere with copying and repair, which can stop a cancer cell dividing. Healthy tissues can also be affected.
agents.watch: Cold can trigger tingling or throat discomfort. Tell the team about persistent numbness, difficulty with buttons or walking, or infusion symptoms. New breathing difficulty always needs assessment.
risks: Persistent sensory neuropathy, sometimes lasting after treatment
Rare serious lung or blood complications
consent_risks: Cold can trigger tingling or throat discomfort. Report persistent numbness, falls or difficulty fastening buttons.
Tell the nurse immediately about swelling, wheeze, faintness or trouble breathing.

agents.name: Capecitabine
agents.explanation: The body converts capecitabine into fluorouracil, which disrupts DNA and RNA processes needed for cell growth. Tablets are active chemotherapy; taking them at home still requires a clear monitoring and interruption plan.
agents.watch: Stop tablets and contact the team for significant diarrhoea, painful mouth ulcers, hand-foot soreness affecting activities, fever or dehydration. Chest pain needs urgent assessment. Do not restart until instructed.
risks: Severe early toxicity including DPD-related toxicity
consent_risks: Hold tablets and call for significant diarrhoea, painful mouth ulcers or hands and feet painful enough to limit activity.
Chest pain or severe early symptoms
Chest pain needs emergency assessment. Severe early diarrhoea, dehydration or fever needs urgent oncology review.

common_effects.title: Mouth and bowel
common_effects.text: Ring for painful ulcers, persistent diarrhoea or inability to drink.

common_effects.title: Fatigue and appetite
common_effects.text: Tell the team about weight loss or difficulty swallowing so that nutrition support can be arranged.

common_effects.title: Nerves and cold
common_effects.text: Avoid cold triggers and report numbness that interferes with buttons or walking.

serious_effects.title: Infection
serious_effects.text: Phone oncology immediately for fever, shivering or sudden illness. For severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or collapse call 112 or 999.

serious_effects.title: Chest pain
serious_effects.text: Fluoropyrimidines can affect blood flow to the heart. Seek emergency help for new severe chest pain.

serious_effects.title: Severe early toxicity
serious_effects.text: Contact oncology immediately for severe diarrhoea, mouth ulcers or fever early in a course.

serious_effects.title: Injection site
serious_effects.text: Tell the nurse straight away about burning, pain or swelling while epirubicin is being given.

evidence.title: REAL-2
evidence.interpretation: In advanced disease, the pooled comparisons supported substitution of capecitabine for infused fluorouracil and oxaliplatin for cisplatin. The trial did not compare these with modern immunotherapy combinations.
evidence.limitations: These results describe selected trial populations. Your outlook depends on your disease, fitness and treatment setting.
